request.query:
GOAL: A short note the person keeps open while booking or at the service desk: which service to choose, what to write in a free-text field, what to bring and when they plan to go, all from the facts. Not an email: no request for a reply.

FACTS:
P1: I arrive in Helsinki on 1 December 2026.
P2: I am an EU citizen, moving to Helsinki for work and study.
F1: How to book: Call the Tax Administration telephone service 029 497 010 (+358 29 497 010 from abroad) to book an appointment
F2: Bring: valid passport or official proof of identity with a photograph
F3: Bring: employment contract
F4: Bring: Application for tax card, tax prepayment or tax number – current or former foreign residents (5042e), for stays over 6 months
F5: Bring: estimate of total annual income including wages and possible fringe benefits, holiday pay, bonuses
F6: How long it takes: usually 1 to 3 business days
P3: I plan to go (Vero) on 1 December 2026.

data.subject: Booking note: personal identity code at Vero

sentences.text: I am an EU citizen moving to Helsinki for work and study, and I arrive on 1 December 2026.
I plan to go to the Vero tax office on 1 December 2026 to ask for a personal identity code.
To book an appointment, I can call the Tax Administration telephone service on 029 497 010 (+358 29 497 010 from abroad).
I need to bring a valid passport or official proof of identity with a photograph.
I also need to bring my employment contract.
I should bring the form "Application for tax card, tax prepayment or tax number – current or former foreign residents (5042e)", which is for stays over 6 months.
I should also bring an estimate of my total annual income, including wages and possible fringe benefits, holiday pay and bonuses.
The process usually takes 1 to 3 business days.
